title: NicheTarget-GNN v1.3.0: code and results for a two-stage pre-specified cross-patient evaluation of spatial target rankings
description: Code, analysis scripts and raw outputs for the manuscript 'Do Artificial Intelligence-Driven Spatial Target Rankings Hold Across Cancer Patients? A Two-Stage Pre-Specified Evaluation of a Graph Neural Network in Breast Cancer' (Thakar and Ghorpade; submitted to Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine). Includes the original single-tumour NicheTarget-GNN analyses, the pre-specified 17-donor replication (results/replication/), the post hoc read-out sensitivity analysis (results/replication_sensitivity/), and the stage-2 evaluation in six unseen tumours with its public pre-specified plan (results/revision/, plan in PRESPECIFIED_REVISION.md).
